s0101.literal: Sadun was dispatched to hold the Liaodong army at Dongliu Sha River east of Jizhou; marshal Arigh was ordered to guard Juyong Pass.
s0101.idiomatic: Sadun was dispatched to hold the Liaodong army at Dongliu Sha River east of Jizhou; marshal Arigh was ordered to guard Juyong Pass.

s0102.literal: Shangdu troops attacked Beilou Pass; commander Yeshutai'er defended it but could not overcome them.
s0102.idiomatic: Shangdu troops attacked Beilou Pass; commander Yeshutai'er defended it but could not overcome them.

s0103.literal: On wuchen day grand minister of agriculture Mingli Dong'a and Dadu garrison commissioner Kuokuotai were both made central secretariat grand councillors.
s0103.idiomatic: On wuchen day grand minister of agriculture Mingli Dong'a and Dadu garrison commissioner Kuokuotai were both made central secretariat grand councillors.

s0104.literal: Brave men were recruited for military service.
s0104.idiomatic: Brave men were recruited for military service.

s0105.literal: Envoys were dispatched in separate columns through Hejian, Baoding, Zhending, and Henan routes and others to requisition civilian horses.
s0105.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched in separate columns through Hejian, Baoding, Zhending, and Henan routes and others to requisition civilian horses.

s0106.literal: The Hexi Army of Yanling County was summoned to court.
s0106.idiomatic: The Hexi Army of Yanling County was summoned to court.

s0107.literal: Xiangyang commander of ten-thousands Yang Kezhong and Dengzhou commander of ten-thousands Sun Jie were ordered to hold Wuguan Pass with troops.
s0107.idiomatic: Xiangyang commander of ten-thousands Yang Kezhong and Dengzhou commander of ten-thousands Sun Jie were ordered to hold Wuguan Pass with troops.

s0108.literal: The Sea Route Office of Commanders of Ten-Thousands was ordered to transport three million one hundred thousand shi of grain the following year.
s0108.idiomatic: The Sea Route Office of Commanders of Ten-Thousands was ordered to transport 3,100,000 shi of grain the following year.

s0110.literal: On jisi day casting of the imperial seal was completed.
s0110.idiomatic: On jisi day casting of the imperial seal was completed.

s0111.literal: A traveling privy council was established at Bianliang; associate privy council administrator Yeshutai'er was made to administer the traveling privy council, leading troops to inspect the passes of the Taihang range, striking west against the armies of Hezhong and Tong Pass, and distributing folding crossbows to the garrison troops holding the passes.
s0111.idiomatic: A traveling privy council was established at Bianliang; associate privy council administrator Yeshutai'er was made to administer the traveling privy council, leading troops to inspect the passes of the Taihang range, striking west against the armies of Hezhong and Tong Pass, and distributing folding crossbows to the garrison troops holding the passes.

s0112.literal: Shangdu princes including Hulatai led troops to invade Guo Prefecture.
s0112.idiomatic: Shangdu princes including Hulatai led troops to invade Guo Prefecture.

s0113.literal: On gengwu day the relevant offices were ordered to purchase one hundred sixty-five thousand shi of grain and beans on the market and distribute them to the troops and horses at Juyong Pass and other passes.
s0113.idiomatic: On gengwu day the relevant offices were ordered to purchase 165,000 shi of grain and beans on the market and distribute them to the troops and horses at Juyong Pass and other passes.

s0114.literal: Soldiers and civilians were dispatched to guard the defiles at Gui and Xia.
s0114.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians were dispatched to guard the defiles at Gui and Xia.

s0115.literal: On xinwei day, in ordinary dress, he visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0115.idiomatic: On xinwei day, in ordinary dress, he visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0116.literal: The native official of Mengding Route in Yunnan came to court to present local products.
s0116.idiomatic: The native official of Mengding Route in Yunnan came to court to present local products.

s0117.literal: Ubaidullah and Temürge were executed at the market; Duodu, Wang Shixi, Barqachar, Toqan, and others were each exiled to distant prefectures, and their households were confiscated.
s0117.idiomatic: Ubaidullah and Temürge were executed at the market; Duodu, Wang Shixi, Barqachar, Toqan, and others were each exiled to distant prefectures, and their households were confiscated.

s0118.literal: Associate privy council administrator Toqtoghan fought Tuman De'er of Liaodong at Liangjiadian in Jizhou.
s0118.idiomatic: Associate privy council administrator Toqtoghan fought Tuman De'er of Liaodong at Liangjiadian in Jizhou.

s0119.literal: On renshen day the Emperor took the throne in Daming Hall, received congratulations from the princes and hundred officials, and proclaimed a general amnesty; the edict said:
s0119.idiomatic: On renshen day the Emperor took the throne in Daming Hall, received congratulations from the princes and hundred officials, and proclaimed a general amnesty; the edict said:

s0120.literal: Greatly do We reflect that Our Founding Emperor unified the realm within the four seas, thereupon established fixed institutions, and with a single succession line had kinsmen each receive allotted domains — none dared rashly harbor covetous designs; this is an immutable settled rule, to be jointly upheld for ten thousand generations.
s0120.idiomatic: Greatly do We reflect that Our Founding Emperor unified the realm within the four seas, thereupon established fixed institutions, and with a single succession line had kinsmen each receive allotted domains — none dared rashly harbor covetous designs; this is an immutable settled rule, to be jointly upheld for ten thousand generations.

s0121.literal: After Shizu, Chengzong, Wuzong, Renzong, and Yingzong, with a mind of holding the realm in common, passed the throne in order; princes and noble kinsmen all obeyed the ancestral instruction.
s0121.idiomatic: After Shizu, Chengzong, Wuzong, Renzong, and Yingzong, with a mind of holding the realm in common, passed the throne in order; princes and noble kinsmen all obeyed the ancestral instruction.

s0122.literal: As for the Jin residence, there existed covenant documents pledging to keep to princely service; yet together with the traitorous ministers Tieshi, Yesen Temür, and others he secretly maintained a hidden plot, presumptuously encroached on the imperial seat, and caused Yingzong unhappily to meet with great misfortune.
s0122.idiomatic: As for the Jin residence, there existed covenant documents pledging to keep to princely service; yet together with the traitorous ministers Tieshi, Yesen Temür, and others he secretly maintained a hidden plot, presumptuously encroached on the imperial seat, and caused Yingzong unhappily to meet with great misfortune.

s0123.literal: We brothers were driven to wander north and south, fully enduring hardship and peril; how could We have shared in matters of rule!
s0123.idiomatic: We brothers were driven to wander north and south, fully enduring hardship and peril; how could We have shared in matters of rule!

s0124.literal: Because of Our uncle's position We dutifully accepted succession in compliance; for six years now, calamities and portents have repeatedly appeared.
s0124.idiomatic: Because of Our uncle's position We dutifully accepted succession in compliance; for 6 years now, calamities and portents have repeatedly appeared.

s0125.literal: Powerful ministers Doresh, Ubaidullah, and others monopolized authority and acted on their own judgment, kept meritorious old followers at a distance, discarded the loyal and good, altered and overturned the ancestral institutions, and emptied the treasury to enrich their faction.
s0125.idiomatic: Powerful ministers Doresh, Ubaidullah, and others monopolized authority and acted on their own judgment, kept meritorious old followers at a distance, discarded the loyal and good, altered and overturned the ancestral institutions, and emptied the treasury to enrich their faction.

s0126.literal: When the late emperor became Heaven's guest, they took advantage of installing a minor, openly grasped the reins of state, and thereby accomplished their treachery.
s0126.idiomatic: When the late emperor became Heaven's guest, they took advantage of installing a minor, openly grasped the reins of state, and thereby accomplished their treachery.

s0127.literal: Princes and great ministers, because of the weight of the altars of state and the correctness of the succession line, joined in counsel to support and install Us, their slight person.
s0127.idiomatic: Princes and great ministers, because of the weight of the altars of state and the correctness of the succession line, joined in counsel to support and install Us, their slight person.

s0128.literal: We, of meager virtue, ought to await Our elder brother and firmly yielded again and again.
s0128.idiomatic: We, of meager virtue, ought to await Our elder brother and firmly yielded again and again.

s0129.literal: Imperial kinsmen, generals and chancellors, the hundred officials, and elders of age held that the imperial regalia could not long remain vacant and the realm could not be without a ruler; the Prince of Zhou was far separated in the northern desert, and the people were anxious — already three months had passed, and their earnest pleas were urgent.
s0129.idiomatic: Imperial kinsmen, generals and chancellors, the hundred officials, and elders of age held that the imperial regalia could not long remain vacant and the realm could not be without a ruler; the Prince of Zhou was far separated in the northern desert, and the people were anxious — already 3 months had passed, and their earnest pleas were urgent.

s0130.literal: We therefore acceded to their request, respectfully awaiting Our elder brother's arrival, to fulfill Our firm intent to yield.
s0130.idiomatic: We therefore acceded to their request, respectfully awaiting Our elder brother's arrival, to fulfill Our firm intent to yield.

s0131.literal: On the thirteenth day of the ninth month of the first year of Zhihe, We already took the imperial throne in Daming Hall; let the first year of Zhihe be renamed the first year of Tianli, and a general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0131.idiomatic: On the 13th day of the ninth month of the first year of Zhihe, We already took the imperial throne in Daming Hall; let the first year of Zhihe be renamed the first year of Tianli, and a general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0132.literal: Before dawn on the thirteenth day of the ninth month, except for plotting to kill grandparents or parents, a wife or concubine killing her husband, a slave killing his master, plotting deliberate murder, robbery in general, and forging counterfeit notes — which are not pardoned — all other crimes, whether light or heavy, are alike remitted and abolished.
s0132.idiomatic: Before dawn on the 13th day of the ninth month, except for plotting to kill grandparents or parents, a wife or concubine killing her husband, a slave killing his master, plotting deliberate murder, robbery in general, and forging counterfeit notes — which are not pardoned — all other crimes, whether light or heavy, are alike remitted and abolished.

s0133.literal: Alas, had We any intent toward the realm!
s0133.idiomatic: Alas, had We any intent toward the realm!

s0134.literal: Deeply reflecting on the hardship of the ancestors' founding, fearing the ruin of the great enterprise, We therefore reluctantly followed the will of the multitude.
s0134.idiomatic: Deeply reflecting on the hardship of the ancestors' founding, fearing the ruin of the great enterprise, We therefore reluctantly followed the will of the multitude.

s0135.literal: We still rely on you civil and military ministers within and without to join hearts in assisting Us, to bring peace to the hundred millions, and to accomplish the work of good governance.
s0135.idiomatic: We still rely on you civil and military ministers within and without to join hearts in assisting Us, to bring peace to the hundred millions, and to accomplish the work of good governance.

s0136.literal: We address you in all quarters — embody Our utmost intent!
s0136.idiomatic: We address you in all quarters — embody Our utmost intent!

s0137.literal: On guiyou day additional relay-seal dispatches were granted to the Hanlin Academy.
s0137.idiomatic: On guiyou day additional relay-seal dispatches were granted to the Hanlin Academy.

s0138.literal: Yan Temür was ordered to lead troops against the Liaodong army; Yan Temür was enfeoffed Prince of Taiping, with Taiping Route as his fief; he was granted five hundred taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, ten thousand ingots of notes, and five hundred qing of Pingjiang official land.
s0138.idiomatic: Yan Temür was ordered to lead troops against the Liaodong army; Yan Temür was enfeoffed Prince of Taiping, with Taiping Route as his fief; he was granted 500 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, 10,000 ingots of notes, and 500 qing of Pingjiang official land.

s0139.literal: Central secretariat right vice chancellor Cao Li was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor; Fujian surveillance commissioner Yishidong'a was made right vice chancellor; former central secretariat left vice chancellor Zhang Siming was made left vice chancellor.
s0139.idiomatic: Central secretariat right vice chancellor Cao Li was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor; Fujian surveillance commissioner Yishidong'a was made right vice chancellor; former central secretariat left vice chancellor Zhang Siming was made left vice chancellor.

s0140.literal: Princes Tashu, Jirhalang, Fobao, and others came to court from En Prefecture.
s0140.idiomatic: Princes Tashu, Jirhalang, Fobao, and others came to court from En Prefecture.

s0141.literal: Anhui was granted one hundred ingots of notes for sacrifice to the Heavenly Spirit.
s0141.idiomatic: Anhui was granted 100 ingots of notes for sacrifice to the Heavenly Spirit.

s0143.literal: On jiaxu day Yan Temür was additionally invested commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies, pillar of state of the upper grade, recorder of state military affairs, central secretariat right chancellor, and supervisor of the state history, while still administering the privy council as before; Bayan was made grand marshal; Jiangnan branch censor-in-chief Durji was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left chancellor; Huai-Xi circuit surveillance commissioner Arslan Qaya was made Jiangnan branch censor-in-chief.
s0143.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Yan Temür was additionally invested commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies, pillar of state of the upper grade, recorder of state military affairs, central secretariat right chancellor, and supervisor of the state history, while still administering the privy council as before; Bayan was made grand marshal; Jiangnan branch censor-in-chief Durji was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left chancellor; Huai-Xi circuit surveillance commissioner Arslan Qaya was made Jiangnan branch censor-in-chief.

s0144.literal: Princes Bolad and Quduqa came to court.
s0144.idiomatic: Princes Bolad and Quduqa came to court.

s0145.literal: The old and young of the left and right Asud guard corps were summoned to the capital; those who did not go were beheaded and their households confiscated.
s0145.idiomatic: The old and young of the left and right Asud guard corps were summoned to the capital; those who did not go were beheaded and their households confiscated.

s0146.literal: On yihai day the Grand Felicitous Court was established to perform sacrifice at the spirit halls of the ancestral imperial portraits, rank 2a; the Huifu and Zhuxiang courts were abolished.
s0146.idiomatic: On yihai day the Grand Felicitous Court was established to perform sacrifice at the spirit halls of the ancestral imperial portraits, rank 2a; the Huifu and Zhuxiang courts were abolished.

s0147.literal: Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Tuq Temür and Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat right vice chancellor Yishidong'a were both made commissioners of the Grand Felicitous Court; central secretariat grand councillor Susu and censorate vice commissioner Yilechi were both additionally commissioners of the Grand Felicitous Court.
s0147.idiomatic: Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Tuq Temür and Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat right vice chancellor Yishidong'a were both made commissioners of the Grand Felicitous Court; central secretariat grand councillor Susu and censorate vice commissioner Yilechi were both additionally commissioners of the Grand Felicitous Court.

s0148.literal: Shangdu Prince Wang Chan's troops made a surprise attack and broke through Juyong Pass; officers and soldiers all fled in rout.
s0148.idiomatic: Shangdu Prince Wang Chan's troops made a surprise attack and broke through Juyong Pass; officers and soldiers all fled in rout.

s0149.literal: Yan Temür's army halted at Sanhe.
s0149.idiomatic: Yan Temür's army halted at Sanhe.

s0150.literal: On bingzi day Wang Chan's roaming troops reached Dakou; Yan Temür returned with his army and halted at the Yu River; the Emperor went out through Qihua Gate to review the troops.
s0150.idiomatic: On bingzi day Wang Chan's roaming troops reached Dakou; Yan Temür returned with his army and halted at the Yu River; the Emperor went out through Qihua Gate to review the troops.

s0151.literal: On dingchou day Yan Temür came to see him and said, "Once the imperial carriage goes forth, the people's hearts will surely be alarmed; as for military affairs, your subject asks to take them upon himself.
s0151.idiomatic: On dingchou day Yan Temür came to see him and said, "Once the imperial carriage goes forth, the people's hearts will surely be alarmed; as for military affairs, your subject asks to take them upon himself.

s0152.literal: " That same day he returned to the palace.
s0152.idiomatic: " That same day he returned to the palace.

s0153.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.
s0153.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.

s0154.literal: On wuyin day an edict was proclaimed to the court and countryside: "Recently the traitorous ministers Doresh and Ubaidullah secretly maintained a hidden plot and altered the ancestral settled institutions; their crimes have already been clearly rectified.
s0154.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict was proclaimed to the court and countryside: "Recently the traitorous ministers Doresh and Ubaidullah secretly maintained a hidden plot and altered the ancestral settled institutions; their crimes have already been clearly rectified.

s0155.literal: All Muslims who did not participate in the affair may keep their livelihoods and need not fear;
s0155.idiomatic: All Muslims who did not participate in the affair may keep their livelihoods and need not fear;

s0156.literal: whoever incites and deludes others among them shall be punished.
s0156.idiomatic: whoever incites and deludes others among them shall be punished.

s0157.literal: " An order was also issued: "Soldiers who desert and return, and vagrants in the capital who dare plunder the people's property, shall be beheaded.
s0157.idiomatic: " An order was also issued: "Soldiers who desert and return, and vagrants in the capital who dare plunder the people's property, shall be beheaded.

s0158.literal: " Gaochang monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Yanchun Pavilion.
s0158.idiomatic: " Gaochang monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Yanchun Pavilion.

s0159.literal: Nestorian Christians were also ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the spirit hall of Empress Manifest Virtue and Solemn Sage.
s0159.idiomatic: Nestorian Christians were also ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the spirit hall of Empress Manifest Virtue and Solemn Sage.

s0160.literal: Princes Arbaqu, Anhui, and Toqto came to court.
s0160.idiomatic: Princes Arbaqu, Anhui, and Toqto came to court.

s0161.literal: The garrison commissioner was ordered to complete the capital's defenses; soldiers manned the walls for defense.
s0161.idiomatic: The garrison commissioner was ordered to complete the capital's defenses; soldiers manned the walls for defense.

s0162.literal: Yan Temür fought Wang Chan's vanguard at the Yu River, defeated them, and pursued the rout north of Red Bridge.
s0162.idiomatic: Yan Temür fought Wang Chan's vanguard at the Yu River, defeated them, and pursued the rout north of Red Bridge.

s0163.literal: Associate privy council administrator Alaltemür and commander Qudu Temür joined Wang Chan with troops and came again to give battle; they were again defeated, and Our army held Red Bridge.
s0163.idiomatic: Associate privy council administrator Alaltemür and commander Qudu Temür joined Wang Chan with troops and came again to give battle; they were again defeated, and Our army held Red Bridge.

s0164.literal: An additional one hundred relay horses were granted to Dadu.
s0164.idiomatic: An additional 100 relay horses were granted to Dadu.

s0165.literal: On gengchen day the Metal Star violated the Horn constellation.
s0165.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Metal Star violated the Horn constellation.

s0166.literal: An edict instructed the censorate: "Henceforth surveillance censors and surveillance commissioners, in all impeachments, must set forth the facts; where there are none, do not speak rashly.
s0166.idiomatic: An edict instructed the censorate: "Henceforth surveillance censors and surveillance commissioners, in all impeachments, must set forth the facts; where there are none, do not speak rashly.

s0167.literal: Surveillance office clerks should be appointed jointly from officeholders, instructors, clerks, and provincial graduates.
s0167.idiomatic: Surveillance office clerks should be appointed jointly from officeholders, instructors, clerks, and provincial graduates.

s0168.literal: " Additional enfeoffment was granted to Han general Guan Yu as Prince Manifest Spirit, Righteous, Valorous, Martial, and Restorative; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at his temple.
s0168.idiomatic: " Additional enfeoffment was granted to Han general Guan Yu as Prince Manifest Spirit, Righteous, Valorous, Martial, and Restorative; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at his temple.

s0169.literal: On xinsi day the Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.
s0169.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.

s0170.literal: Bayanbuluq was made privy council administrator, while still central secretariat left grand councillor.
s0170.idiomatic: Bayanbuluq was made privy council administrator, while still central secretariat left grand councillor.

s0172.literal: Yan Temür fought a great battle with the Shangdu army on the plain of Baifu; Yan Temür personally slew seven men in the ranks and defeated them.
s0172.idiomatic: Yan Temür fought a great battle with the Shangdu army on the plain of Baifu; Yan Temür personally slew 7 men in the ranks and defeated them.

s0173.literal: Toqtoghan fought the Liaodong army at Tanzishan in Jizhou.
s0173.idiomatic: Toqtoghan fought the Liaodong army at Tanzishan in Jizhou.

s0174.literal: On renwu day there was heavy fog.
s0174.idiomatic: On renwu day there was heavy fog.

s0175.literal: Wang Chan and others fled to Kunshan Prefecture.
s0175.idiomatic: Wang Chan and others fled to Kunshan Prefecture.

s0176.literal: Envoys bearing edicts from Shangdu and envoys mobilizing troops from Liaodong were captured and reported; an edict ordered them executed.
s0176.idiomatic: Envoys bearing edicts from Shangdu and envoys mobilizing troops from Liaodong were captured and reported; an edict ordered them executed.

s0177.literal: On guiwei day associate privy council administrator Toghan Temür was made privy council administrator; central secretariat grand councillor Mingli Dong'a was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor.
s0177.idiomatic: On guiwei day associate privy council administrator Toghan Temür was made privy council administrator; central secretariat grand councillor Mingli Dong'a was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor.

s0178.literal: Wang Chan gathered the scattered and came again to give battle; Our army drew up ranks west of Baifu, and the enemy did not dare attack.
s0178.idiomatic: Wang Chan gathered the scattered and came again to give battle; Our army drew up ranks west of Baifu, and the enemy did not dare attack.

s0179.literal: By night Sadun and Toqtoghan attacked from front and rear, defeated and drove them off, pursued them north of Changping, beheaded several thousand, and accepted the surrender of more than ten thousand.
s0179.idiomatic: By night Sadun and Toqtoghan attacked from front and rear, defeated and drove them off, pursued them north of Changping, beheaded several thousand, and accepted the surrender of more than 10,000.

s0180.literal: The Emperor dispatched envoys to grant Yan Temür imperial wine and instructed him: "Each time the chancellor goes into battle he personally braves arrows and stones; if unexpectedly something should happen, what then?
s0180.idiomatic: The Emperor dispatched envoys to grant Yan Temür imperial wine and instructed him: "Each time the chancellor goes into battle he personally braves arrows and stones; if unexpectedly something should happen, what then?

s0181.literal: From now on it will suffice to direct the battle with the great general's banner and drum.
s0181.idiomatic: From now on it will suffice to direct the battle with the great general's banner and drum.

s0182.literal: " Yan Temür replied, "In every battle your subject must take the lead in person; whoever dares hang back is judged by military law.
s0182.idiomatic: " Yan Temür replied, "In every battle your subject must take the lead in person; whoever dares hang back is judged by military law.

s0183.literal: If it were entrusted to the generals and they should fail, what regret would there be time for?
s0183.idiomatic: If it were entrusted to the generals and they should fail, what regret would there be time for?

s0184.literal: " On jiashen day auspicious clouds appeared.
s0184.idiomatic: " On jiashen day auspicious clouds appeared.

s0185.literal: Wang Chan fled alone on horseback; Sadun pursued but could not overtake him and returned.
s0185.idiomatic: Wang Chan fled alone on horseback; Sadun pursued but could not overtake him and returned.

s0186.literal: The censorate was ordered: "For all surveillance commissioners in each circuit, appoint two Mongols, and one each from Uighur, Hexi, Muslim, and Han;
s0186.idiomatic: The censorate was ordered: "For all surveillance commissioners in each circuit, appoint 2 Mongols, and 1 each from Uighur, Hexi, Muslim, and Han;

s0187.literal: sixteen clerks in each office — five officeholders, five route clerks, two instructors, and four provincial graduates.
s0187.idiomatic: 16 clerks in each office — 5 officeholders, 5 route clerks, 2 instructors, and 4 provincial graduates.

s0188.literal: Central office administrators of equivalent rank are to be appointed surveillance commissioners; office managers are to be appointed vice commissioners.
s0188.idiomatic: Central office administrators of equivalent rank are to be appointed surveillance commissioners; office managers are to be appointed vice commissioners.

s0189.literal: Henceforth censorate translators and interpreters who complete their term of service may not be appointed censors.
s0189.idiomatic: Henceforth censorate translators and interpreters who complete their term of service may not be appointed censors.

s0190.literal: " Prince Jing'an Kokebuluq and others led Shaanxi troops in secretly entering through Tong Pass's southern water gate; commander of ten-thousands Bolad abandoned the pass and fled; Kokebuluq and others separately occupied Shaan Prefecture and other counties and let their troops plunder on all sides.
s0190.idiomatic: " Prince Jing'an Kokebuluq and others led Shaanxi troops in secretly entering through Tong Pass's southern water gate; commander of ten-thousands Bolad abandoned the pass and fled; Kokebuluq and others separately occupied Shaan Prefecture and other counties and let their troops plunder on all sides.

s0191.literal: On yiyou day Mingli Dong'a was made central secretariat grand councillor; Lingbei branch secretariat left vice chancellor Yanbulu was made privy council administrator.
s0191.idiomatic: On yiyou day Mingli Dong'a was made central secretariat grand councillor; Lingbei branch secretariat left vice chancellor Yanbulu was made privy council administrator.

s0192.literal: One thousand able-bodied men were recruited to defend the walled cities.
s0192.idiomatic: 1,000 able-bodied men were recruited to defend the walled cities.

s0193.literal: Shangdu troops entered Gubeikou Pass; officers and soldiers all fled in rout; privy council administrator Juwentai led troops to plunder Shicao.
s0193.idiomatic: Shangdu troops entered Gubeikou Pass; officers and soldiers all fled in rout; privy council administrator Juwentai led troops to plunder Shicao.

s0194.literal: Posthumous enfeoffment was granted to wet nurse Wanzhe as Lady of the Yun State; her husband Oros was posthumously made grand preceptor and enfeoffed Duke of the Yun State, posthumous name Zhongyi;
s0194.idiomatic: Posthumous enfeoffment was granted to wet nurse Wanzhe as Lady of the Yun State; her husband Oros was posthumously made grand preceptor and enfeoffed Duke of the Yun State, posthumous name Zhongyi;

s0195.literal: her son Sonai was posthumously made minister of works and enfeoffed Duke of the Yun State, posthumous name Zhenmin.
s0195.idiomatic: her son Sonai was posthumously made minister of works and enfeoffed Duke of the Yun State, posthumous name Zhenmin.

s0196.literal: Yan Temür dispatched Sadun by forced march to rush to Shicao and strike them unprepared.
s0196.idiomatic: Yan Temür dispatched Sadun by forced march to rush to Shicao and strike them unprepared.

s0197.literal: Yan Temür's main army followed; fighting continued for more than forty li to Niutou Mountain; imperial son-in-law Bolad Temür, grand councillor Mongol Tashi, Yeshi Temür, and director of the Palace Construction Office Sar Toghan were captured and sent to court for execution; commanders who surrendered numbered ten thousand, and the remaining troops fled in disorder; by night Sadun was dispatched out through Gubeikou Pass to pursue them.
s0197.idiomatic: Yan Temür's main army followed; fighting continued for more than 40 li to Niutou Mountain; imperial son-in-law Bolad Temür, grand councillor Mongol Tashi, Yeshi Temür, and director of the Palace Construction Office Sar Toghan were captured and sent to court for execution; commanders who surrendered numbered 10,000, and the remaining troops fled in disorder; by night Sadun was dispatched out through Gubeikou Pass to pursue them.

s0198.literal: Toqtoghan fought the Liaodong army south of Jizhou; the slain and captured were beyond reckoning.
s0198.idiomatic: Toqtoghan fought the Liaodong army south of Jizhou; the slain and captured were beyond reckoning.

s0199.literal: Fifty thousand old and young of the Henan Mongol army were mobilized to reinforce the capital's defense; able-bodied men were recruited to guard Zhigu.
s0199.idiomatic: 50,000 old and young of the Henan Mongol army were mobilized to reinforce the capital's defense; able-bodied men were recruited to guard Zhigu.

s0200.literal: Three thousand five hundred transport troops of the Linqing Office of Commanders of Ten-Thousands were mobilized for divided garrison along the Imperial Canal; ten thousand able-bodied men of Shandong were ordered to defend the seaports at Yidu, Panyang, and other places.
s0200.idiomatic: 3,500 transport troops of the Linqing Office of Commanders of Ten-Thousands were mobilized for divided garrison along the Imperial Canal; 10,000 able-bodied men of Shandong were ordered to defend the seaports at Yidu, Panyang, and other places.
